children: Spark I Acquisition entered into a promissory note with its sponsor to fund monthly extension contributions and support its trust account. The unsecured, interest-free note provides up to $400,000 and is repayable upon the earlier of a business combination or Mar 29, 2027. Beginning Oct 1, 2026, the sponsor will deposit $0.015 per public share monthly, up to about $201,304, following shareholder approval of the extension. The financing is expected to preserve cash in trust while the company pursues its initial business combination.
: Unsecured promissory note for extension funding
: Support extension and maintain trust account value
